{{short description|German inorganic chemist}}

'''Stefanie Dehnen''' (born 31 May 1969) is a German chemist.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.adwmainz.de/mitglieder/profil/prof-dr-stefanie-dehnen.html|title=Prof. Dr. Stefanie Dehnen : Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur {{!}} Mainz|website=www.adwmainz.de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-marburg.de/fb15/ag-dehnen/stefaniedehnen/CV2018-SD-ENGLISCH.pdf|title=Stefanie Dehnen|last=|first=|date=|website=www.uni-marburg.de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|date=2016|title=Stefanie Dehnen|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=55|issue=11|pages=3542|doi=10.1002/anie.201601527|issn=1521-3773}}</ref> She is the executive director of the Institute of Nanotechnology at the [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Webmaster |first=I. N. T. |date=2022-01-10 |title=INT- People - Staff Index (A-Z) |url=https://www.int.kit.edu/staff_stefanie-dehnen.php |access-date=2022-10-02 |website=www.int.kit.edu |language=en-gb}}</ref> From 2006 to 2022, she was a full professor for inorganic chemistry at the [[University of Marburg]].<ref name=":0" /> She has received numerous awards for her research in inorganic chemistry. In 2024 and 2025, she will be the president of the [[German Chemical Society]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite tweet |number=1699033095905665056 |user=GDCh_aktuell |title=Als Präsidentin der GDCh für die Jahre 2024/2025 gewählt: Prof Dr Stefanie Dehnen. Wir gratulieren! @DehnenStefanie |access-date=2023-09-05 |language=de |url=https://twitter.com/GDCh_aktuell/status/1699033095905665056}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> 

== Education and professional life ==
Dehnen studied Chemistry at the [[University of Karlsruhe]] from 1988 to 1993.<ref name=":0" /> She finished her doctoral degree in Chemistry in the group of [[Dieter Fenske]] in 1996 and she completed her habilitation at the [[University of Karlsruhe]] in 2004.<ref name=":0" /> She was a full professor for inorganic chemistry at the [[University of Marburg]] from 2006 to 2022.<ref name=":0" /> Since October 2022, she is the executive director of the Institute of Nanotechnology at the [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]].<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Twitter Post by Stefanie Dehnen on her new position |url=https://twitter.com/dehnenstefanie/status/1576201897337573376 |access-date=2022-10-02 |website=Twitter |language=en}}</ref> Since 2022, she is also Editor in Chief of the Journal [[Inorganic Chemistry (journal)]].<ref>{{Cite tweet |title=We are thrilled to announce the next Editor-in-Chief |number=1590062667082899459 |user=inorgchem |archive-date=2023-07-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230715050202/https://twitter.com/inorgchem/status/1590062667082899459 |access-date=15 July 2023 |lang=en |url-access=limited |url-status=live |url=https://twitter.com/inorgchem/status/1590062667082899459}}</ref>

==Personal life==
She is married and has 4 children.<ref name=":2" />

== Research ==
Her research focuses on the synthesis, the formation mechanisms, the stability, the reactivity, and the physical properties of compounds and materials with binary and ternary chalcogenidometalate anions, organotetrel chalcogenide compounds, binary Zintl anions and ternary intermetalloid clusters.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-marburg.de/fb15/ag-dehnen/stefaniedehnen|title=Lebenslauf - Philipps-Universität Marburg - Arbeitsgruppe Dehnen|last=Dehnen|date=|website=www.uni-marburg.de|language=de|access-date=2018-12-28}}</ref>

Three of her most-cited publications are:

* {{Cite journal|last1=Bron|first1=Philipp|last2=Johansson|first2=Sebastian|last3=Zick|first3=Klaus|last4=Schmedt auf der Günne|first4=Jörn|last5=Dehnen|first5=Stefanie|last6=Roling|first6=Bernhard|date=2013-10-23|title=Li 10 SnP 2 S 12 : An Affordable Lithium Superionic Conductor|journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society|language=en|volume=135|issue=42|pages=15694–15697|doi=10.1021/ja407393y|pmid=24079534|issn=0002-7863}}
* {{Cite journal|last1=Dehnen|first1=Stefanie|last2=Melullis|first2=Maike|date=May 2007|title=A coordination chemistry approach towards ternary M/14/16 anions|journal=Coordination Chemistry Reviews|language=en|volume=251|issue=9–10|pages=1259–1280|doi=10.1016/j.ccr.2006.11.003}}
* {{Cite journal|last1=Fuhr|first1=Olaf|last2=Dehnen|first2=Stefanie|last3=Fenske|first3=Dieter|date=2013|title=Chalcogenide clusters of copper and silver from silylated chalcogenide sources|journal=Chem. Soc. Rev.|language=en|volume=42|issue=4|pages=1871–1906|doi=10.1039/C2CS35252D|pmid=22918377|issn=0306-0012}}

== Awards ==
She has been awarded the Wöhler Young Scientists Award of the [[Society of German Chemists]] in 2004 and the State of Baden-Württemberg Teaching Award in 2005.<ref name=":1" /> Since 2016, Dehnen is a full member of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] and the [[Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur|Mainz Academy of Sciences and Literature]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adw-goe.de/mitglieder/personendetails/person/stefanie-dehnen/|title=Prof. Dr. Stefanie Dehnen:&nbsp;Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen (AdW)|website=adw-goe.de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref> In 2018, she was awarded the Philipps-Universität Marburg Award for Support of Women in Science of the [[University of Marburg]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-marburg.de/de/fb15/aktuelles/nachrichten/frauenfoerderpreis-der-philipps-universitaet-2018-an-frau-prof-dr-stefanie-dehnen-verliehen|title=Frauenförderpreis der Philipps-Universität 2018 an Frau Prof. Dr. Stefanie Dehnen verliehen|website=Philipps-Universität Marburg|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref> As the third woman (after [[Margot Becke-Goehring|Margot Becke]] and [[Marianne Baudler]]), she was awarded the [[Alfred Stock Memorial Prize]] in 2020.<ref>{{citation|periodical=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|title=GDCh Awards 2020/DBG Awards 2020|date=2020-06-11|volume=59|issue=28|pages=11189–11190|language=de|doi=10.1002/anie.202005849|pmid=32529688|s2cid=219606004|url=http://doi.wiley.com/10.1002/anie.202005849
|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Alfred Stock Memorial Award for Stefanie Dehnen :: ChemViews Magazine :: ChemistryViews|url=https://www.chemistryviews.org/details/ezine/11316513/Alfred_Stock_Memorial_Award_for_Stefanie_Dehnen.html|access-date=2021-08-31|website=www.chemistryviews.org|date=31 August 2021 |language=en}}</ref> Moreover, she will give the [[Margot Becke-Goehring|Margot Becke]] lecture in 2020.<ref>{{cite web|periodical=|title=CV
